author: Amr Kadry (github.com/Amrkadry)
catalog: C# hardening — gaps mined from Security Code Scan (SCS0001-0034), Microsoft CA security analyzers (CA2100/23xx/30xx/53xx-54xx) and Puma Scan against the existing A-Z catalog (2026-10-08)

categories.CH: C# hardening: distinguished-name injection, membership password policy, typed-deserialization surfaces, file races, dynamic serializers, shell escape via PowerShell

tests.title: LDAP distinguished name injection
tests.lookFor: DirectoryEntry paths, Rename/MoveTo/Invoke arguments or DN components built by concatenating unescaped input (SCS0026)
tests.expected: DN special characters (\, /, #, +, <, >, ;, leading/trailing space) escaped before use in a distinguished name

tests.title: Membership password policy weak or unspecified
tests.lookFor: <membership> provider without minRequiredPasswordLength, or with it below 8; no passwordStrengthRegularExpression (SCS0032/0033/0034)
tests.expected: minimum length >= 8 (NIST: 15 without MFA) plus complexity/strength expression, or ASP.NET Identity defaults

tests.title: DataSet.ReadXml without type restriction
tests.lookFor: DataSet/DataTable.ReadXml over untrusted streams in default XmlReadMode (CA5370, CVE-2020-1147 family)
tests.expected: XmlReadMode.ReadSchema with a trusted schema, or Deny and allow types via XmlSchema with explicit restriction

tests.title: File.Exists check racing the later open
tests.lookFor: File.Exists(path) guarding File.Open/Delete/Move on the same path — the answer is stale before use (CWE-367)
tests.expected: open in a try/catch and handle FileNotFoundException/IOException instead of pre-checking existence

tests.title: XmlSerializer constructed from a caller-controlled type
tests.lookFor: new XmlSerializer(Type.GetType(<variable>)) or Assembly-qualified type names from input (CA5369)
tests.expected: a fixed set of known serializers built at startup; never resolve serializer types from input

tests.title: PowerShell launched through a shell with dynamic command text
tests.lookFor: Process.Start of powershell/pwsh with -Command, -EncodedCommand or -File built from concatenation or interpolation
tests.expected: no shell delegation; fixed script files with parameter binding; allowlisted arguments only

tests.title: NTLM credentials exposed to non-domain endpoints
tests.lookFor: DefaultCredentials/DefaultNetworkCredentials used against non-Windows or internet-reachable hosts — NTLM auth material leaks to systems that should never see it
tests.expected: explicit credentials scoped per-endpoint; Negotiate with NTLM blocked where the peer is not domain-joined
